title: pm-dispatch: an open PR names its owner — pr_create assigns the claim's Account, a hand-over re-assigns it, and H76 reports an unowned PR

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMkvesLnTm6vYxaHQzFtixa)_

Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:按裁决 A 落地「PR 挂处理人」。开发经中继 `pr_create` 开 PR 时就把处理人挂成认领评论里的 `Account:`(即卡的处理人);换手(兄弟席接管、释放、改派)与认领变更同笔改 PR 处理人;交棒请审时仍 ⛔ 不请席位自己的账号。半状态巡查新增 H76 行:开着的、非信箱 PR 没有处理人就列出来(只报告,不是门禁)。
- **为什么改**:原规则禁止 PR 挂处理人,实测今天开着的 52 个 PR 里 0 个有处理人,GitHub 列表上看不出谁负责,排查闲置 PR 只能逐个读评论。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `.claude/**` 规则文本(Tier S)与 `scripts/pm/` 巡查工具,不发布(`skip-changeset`)。中继本来就支持 `pr_create` 带 `assignees`,不改代码。H76 不写任何标签、处理人或评论,不挡合并。各规则文件行数不变、每行仍在 120 字节内,未抬任何上限。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 认领节第 69 行(规则本体与换手同笔);② `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h76OpenPrWithoutAssignee` 与 sweep 里的接线;③ `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 第 198–199 行(交棒请审只留「不请席位自身账号」)。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,末行电池清单里应见 `H76 unowned open PR 12/11`,并以 0 退出。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(Tier S,席位达档复核 PASS 且全绿后落地;存量 PR 的一次性补挂由席位在规则落地后经中继执行)。

## What changes

Ruling record 6674390671 (letter A, maintainer 「按推荐裁」) on #29828, encoded in the three texts it names plus every restatement found under `.claude/**`:

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` rule 2 (L38): the PR's assignee is the claim's `Account:`, carried by `pr_create`; a hand-over is the seat's. Was 「PR ⛔ 不带 `assignees`(中继虽收),席位交棒才派」.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` write budget (L62): `pr_create` carries labels and assignees. Was 「⛔ 无 assignees」.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` 认领 (L69; L67 at `1371b9d8`): the PR is assigned to the claim's account and a hand-over re-assigns it in the same stroke. Was 「PR ⛔ 不派席位账号」.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` hand-off step ③ (L198-199): 「⛔ 永不派/请席位自身账号」 keeps only the request half (the ruling replaces the assign half alone; a review request to the seat's own account stays forbidden); 「`pr_create` 不请不派」 becomes 「`pr_create` 派不请」.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` (L140): a card thread does not write the CARD's assignee — the PR's is now written by its `pr_create`.
- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: row **H76**, report-only, band `state` (H1's): an open PR with no assignee, a `pm:mailbox` PR excepted. The mailbox label is `mailbox-open.mjs`'s `MAILBOX_LABEL`, imported lazily as H72 does; when it cannot be loaded every unowned PR fires UNJUDGED, never clean. Drafts are included. Free: it reads the open listing the sweep already holds. ⛔ No gate wiring.

Every file keeps its line count (each edit rewrites its own line in place) and every touched line stays within the 120-byte line budget; no ceiling moved.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: new battery `H76 unowned open PR` (12 cases, pin 11): the firing, a ready PR firing like a draft, the assignee exemption (list field and legacy single field), the mailbox exemption beside its unlabelled twin, closed and missing rows, the unread-label UNJUDGED leg for null / undefined / empty, an assigned PR staying clean with the label unread, not-loud, band + emitted, the lazy-import wiring, the roster floor.
- Live probe (read-only, offline predicate over a REST listing, 2026-11-06 ~03:05Z): 52 open PRs, 0 assigned, 13 unassigned `pm:mailbox` PRs exempt, 39 would fire H76.

## Acceptance notes

- The relay needs no change: `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs` accepts `assignees` on `pr_create` (its own self-test pins the shape) and `ops.mjs` sends it as the second leg. Two relay COMMENTS still restate the old rule — the `ops.mjs` header (L103-105, "a dev's `pr_create` carries no `assignees` at all") and the `pr_create` row comment (L2093-2094). They are outside this card's surface while PR #30782 edits `ops.mjs`; carrier: the seat's relay-docs follow-up card.
- `AGENTS.md` L403-404 restates the old rule ("nor the PR's: `pr_create` carries none; the seat sets it at hand-over"). `AGENTS.md` is Tier H and outside this card's surface; carrier: the seat files it.
- The relay's governed-review plan (`execute.mjs`, `pr_ready`) and H43 count an ASSIGNED approver as covered. A claim's `Account:` is never a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account by rule (SKILL.md: an approval account never sits a seat), so the new assignee cannot mask a review request; noted because one open card (#30292) carries an approver account as assignee — its PR is not on a governed path today.
- H76 reads no "unassigned with a note" exemption: a bot PR the seat leaves unassigned keeps reporting each sweep (report-only). Assigning the owning lane seat's account, the ruling's first arm, silences it.
- The one-time backfill is NOT run here: the per-PR list (PR → card → assignee to set) is in the report comment on #29828, for the seat to run through the relay after this lands.
- Numbered H76 because H75 is PR #30778's.

## Verification

Local subset, recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE` and reconciled with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`:

- At `7c76c755` (this change before the `origin/main` merge): all **58** derived families exit 0, reconciliation 58 derived / 58 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED; `pnpm lint` exit 0. That run includes `check:pm-half-states`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates`.
- The head carries one more commit, a plain merge of `origin/main` (bringing in PR #30778, which also edits `os-dev.md`, `SKILL.md` and `check-half-states.mjs`); the branch's delta against `main` is byte-identical (5 files, +92 / -6). The same 58 families are re-run on that head; their record is in the os-dev report on #29828.
- CI families (Lint & Repo Gates, Test Core and the rest) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
